slides.headline: *mars* turns retrograde in *virgo* today, and it stays backwards until april
slides.dek: what it means for your love life, sign by sign

slides.headline: the planet of *drive* looks like it's walking backwards
slides.body: from earth, mars appears to slow, stop and reverse for about 11 weeks. astrologers read it as a time to redo, not start.

slides.headline: virgo, it's happening in your sign, so you feel it first.
slides.body: mars stations at 10° virgo on jan 10. read it as a pause on the plan you were pushing hardest. the fix you keep putting off is the work now. and the person who keeps asking for a second chance? say the honest thing, once.

slides.headline: you don't have to *fix* anyone before february
“mars retrograde means you'll break up”
slides.body: mars retrograde is an optical effect: earth passes mars, so it looks like it moves backwards. astrologers read it as slower, more tired energy, not a breakup timer. if a relationship ends now, it was already ending.

slides.headline: slow is not *stuck*. it's the redo.
slides.body: save this for april 1, when mars turns direct.
